C2_elemB_lane_crossing (slew).violation: u_m.w_r[244]$_DFF_P_/D slew 350.78 TT / 330.29 FF vs 320 (same in the original c8 and the m5 ECO). Path t_r[244] (208.2,165.8) -> INVx1 -> place3528 BUFx3 -> net3527 139.4 um M2 + 2.0 um M3 along the inter-ROM channel (y 166) -> w_r[244] (68.0,166.1). RCX: C 32.4 fF, wire delay 109 ps, slew 351. GRT: C 25.5 fF, wire 49 ps, slew 172 -> the post-GRT repair_design (40% slew margin, target 192) never saw it.
C2_elemB_lane_crossing (slew).structural_cause: ROM R0 puts rd_out bits 0..129 on its W edge and 130..273 on its E edge (LEF), i.e. word lanes 0-7 W, lanes 8-15 E. The parent pin plan put x[] of lanes 0-7 on the E/S faces (E 80, S 48) and lanes 8-15 on the W face (128). Each multiplier lane needs its word slice (w_r, from the ROM side) AND its x slice (x_r, from the face): GPL put every lane next to its x pins, i.e. on the far side of the ROM from its word bits. Result: t_r -> w_r Manhattan median 89.5 um, p90 183.9, max 212.2, 124/256 bits > 100 um, mostly as long M2 runs through the 23-um inter-ROM channel. elemA (same RTL lane structure, ROM R0, x pins of lanes 0-8 on W/S, 9-15 on S/E) is consistent: t_r -> w_r median 15.0 um, 13 > 100.

causes.C3_vclk_contract_FF (both; for CLOCK, no: The element SDC fixes vclk source latency 250 ps at BOTH corners while the element's own tree scales with the corner: B face flops TT 234.8 / FF 169.7 (insertion incl. the -120 early source scales 0.816), A FF 155.4. At TT the contract is matched (~250); at FF every output launch is 80-95 ps before vclk + 12.5 hold uncertainty, so every output path must carry ~60-80 ps of FF hold delay by construction (B fault: hold28495/28496 buffers). A real parent's own tree also runs ~0.8x at FF, so a corner-fixed 250 overstates FF interface hold. Request to CLOCK: corner-consistent interface latency (vclk FF latency = the parent's FF pin-register latency, or early/late per corner) in the core-latency contract. Until CLOCK rules, the fixes below keep the contract unchanged; the output hold delay is then inserted pre-route by the calibrated repair, not by an ECO.

fix_proposed.shared_flow_default (both, pre-route, no: Hold repair runs on RCX-calibrated layer C: tools/s81_head/hd_elemA_rebuild.py --hold-rc-cal 'M2:2.97127E-02:1.08E-01,M4:1.80365E-02:1.0E-01,M5:1.89935E-02:0.95E-01' wraps the POST_GLOBAL_ROUTE hold repair (margin 15) in set_layer_rc + estimate_parasitics -global_routing, then restores platform setRC for setup/DRV (same pattern as main tools/orfs_hold_mm.tcl RC-CAL for M6/M7, extended to the M2-M5 element stack). Lower C on signal wires only makes hold data delays smaller -> conservative for hold. No SDC, clock contract, RTL or cycle change.
fix_proposed.elemA (one structural fix): = the shared default (C1 is A's only cause: 69 ps estimator error > the 45-ps output margin). Rebuild from synth with the same floorplan/ROM sites/pins, --early-ps 160 --post-grt-hold-ps 15 --hold-rc-cal <fit>.
fix_proposed.elemB (one structural fix): Mirror both ROMs (--rom-orient MY, same sites 77.76/103.68 and 77.76/190.08) so word bits of lanes 0-7 leave on the E edge with their E/S x pins and lanes 8-15 on the W edge with their W x pins: each lane's two operand sources on one side, t_r -> w_r expected <~40 um (A shows 15). ROM ctl/addr/clk pins move to the E edge bottom (addr counter + ce flops follow, local). Plus the shared calibrated hold default and MAX_WIRE_LENGTH 100 um (no unbuffered >100 um register transport). Element LEF/pins unchanged, so no parent re-pin.
fix_proposed.not_done: No ECO, no hold-buffer/resize/LVT tweak, no SDC relaxation, no vclk change.
